title: Writing — Isiah Fletcher
description: Essays, reflections, and poetry by Isiah Fletcher.
heading: Words gathered along the way.
intro: An archive of essays, reflections, and poetry. Some published elsewhere, some kept here.

cards.heading: Gimbles and Toads
cards.body: On Substack, I've shared essays about philosophy, creativity, memory, and the strange business of being human. Some are personal; others begin with an idea and follow it wherever it leads.

cards.heading: Poetry and other writing
cards.body: Some of my poems are collected on the site's earlier Hobbies page. They're part of this archive too.

sections.heading: From Substack
sections.fallbackText: The latest essays are available directly on Substack.
